founderRole: Building a little help for the garden.
storyIntro: What stops people from having their own gardens?
storyParagraphs: That’s the idea I’m exploring with Spacefruit. I’m building a modular garden robot, starting with the details that make useful work possible: an arm, a camera and tools that can change with the task.
This is a project in progress. I want to share the real process, from CAD and 3D-printed parts to assembly, testing and the changes that come next.
The ambition is simple: technology that makes room for people, plants and a little more possibility.
